The '''Mos Eisley Medical Center''' was a [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]] located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Nillika]] was the [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]] of the medcenter.<ref name="SWG:CitC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Medic|Caught in the Crossfire|Tatooine}}</ref> A [[Medic/Legends|medic]] by the name of [[Kazen Harn]] operated out of this facility.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mos Eisley Medical Center was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
